purpose: Concise student expectation copy for coordinator-queued app integration after the current beta-2 phase, not an extra maintained prompt or programmatic state machine.
shortCopy: Your AI should say what it can access and start when it has enough material. If something essential is missing, it should tell you exactly what to upload or answer next.
expandedCopy: For bigger tasks, save the working checkpoint and bring it with the needed sources when resuming. Import only the finished notebook JSON. If a file fails, send the actual file and error; missing content must not be guessed. These are instructions for your chosen AI, not a guarantee of its behavior.
